interface.shortDescription: Cross-vendor peer review of the current diff.
interface.longDescription: Peer Review runs an independent, cross-vendor review of the current diff through OpenAI's codex CLI. It is deliberately never the same model reviewing its own work: a second vendor's model shares fewer blind spots with the author. Findings come back as structured, severity-ranked items ready to act on.
